text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look! That's the person who's
always on TV.
You know the one...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was delicious. ♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! What a coincidence
meeting you
here.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I have a big job coming up, so I thought
I'd give
myself a boost by eating a
scrumptious meal.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Come now, you're exaggerating! I'm
barely
keeping up with what I have now.
choice_data_list: Your success just keeps on growing.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
My ideal is still a long way off.
...And I'm
only
losing more ground.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe. ♪ Well then, I should get
going, but
thanks for checking in on me.
choice_data_list: Aiming for the ideal first, you mean?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And if you're not too busy, make
sure to turn
your TV on tonight at seven!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's nearing seven o'clock, so I turn on
the TV just
as Light Hello suggested...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She only has one dream. And that's to
make
Umamusume shine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On tonight's episode of Umamusume World, we follow the journey of this talented event producer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Let's get these props carried in!
Wardrobe, be
ready at the stage wings!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Let's treat this rehearsal like the real
thing. Putting together a stage that
dazzles the
audience is what we're all
here for!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As soon as she has returned to the
office, it's time for another meeting. But
even with such a hectic schedule, she
doesn't show the slightest hint of 
fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Then how about this as an alternative?
We could
dedicate a camera to each
performer and stream
it online.

text_block_list.name: Business Associate
text_block_list.text:
I see, that would offer a unique
experience
compared to watching it
live... Quite the novel
approach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her talents in such great demand,
we
assumed she must work practically
nonstop.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, I make sure to take days off!
Recently,
I've visited an art gallery and
an amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It's important to take breaks and refresh.
Not to
mention, a change of scenery can
often lead to
some innovative ideas. ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She boasts incredible passion and a keen
eye.
Even time spent away from work is
used to her
advantage.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your kind words. But this
way of
life isn't something I discovered
alone.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
There's a certain trainer I've watched for
about three years. This person plows
straight ahead,
overcoming all
challenges.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And yet... when I was about to collapse,
this
trainer stopped to give me a hand.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I had found someone who believed my
character
traits were talents. Someone
who taught me the
importance of rest.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't met this trainer... I may have
given up
on my dream.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: And that's why I made a decision.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I will no longer be the one in need of
help. I want
to run with them,
side-by-side.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
At least, I'd like to... But this trainer
keeps
reaching greater heights, while I'm
left behind.
Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
But I'll keep building up
accomplishments so I can catch up
someday. That is my aspiration—my

ideal.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And with that, it's about time for me to
head to
my next job!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to stand still when I have
someone
to chase after!
